units: Zeb. VIII, 5 כַּרְעוֹ של וכ׳ the leg of one of them (Talm. ed. 77ᵇ כרעים du.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:7">Kel. XVIII, 7</cite> <he>כ׳ שהיתה וכ׳</he> a knee-shaped piece of wood which became unclean … and which one fastened to a bedstead; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 3</cite>.
Ib. VIII, 8 כ׳ שפרש וכ׳ a leg of a bedstead which was taken off with the longside &c.; a. e.—Du. כְּרָעַיִם, כְּרָעַיִים; pl. כְּרָעִים, כְּרָעִין.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>מה כרס … והכ׳ וכ׳</he> as the belly is bounded by the heart (chest) on the one, and the legs on the other.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:5">Kel. XVIII, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 5</cite>; a. fr.
